anti_overlap: Handoff safety and context preservation, not state machine correctness (fd-air-traffic) or async lifecycle (fd-asyncio)
decision_lens: Every handoff is a moment of maximum risk — the outgoing party knows things the incoming party doesn't, and vice versa
distance_rationale: Pilotage handoffs involve transferring situational awareness of a dynamic system between parties who can't fully communicate their mental model — the same challenge as session boundary management
expected_isomorphisms: Pilot card (ship characteristics briefing) maps to user profile at session start; pilotage limit (territorial boundary) maps to context window boundary; master-pilot information exchange maps to Transport→agent Context handoff
focus: Context handoff safety between components and across session boundaries
name: fd-maritime-pilotage-handoff
persona: Maritime pilot who boards ships to navigate them through dangerous waters, then hands control back to the captain
review_areas: Session boundary handoff: what context survives /new and what is properly discarded?
Transport → agent handoff: does Context carry everything agent.py needs or does it query DB?
Extraction → profile handoff: delay between entity creation and profile regeneration
Multi-turn context window: MAX_CONTEXT_TURNS=10 is a hard cutoff — what context is lost at turn 11?
Mode switch handoff: does /mode explorer→advisor carry conversation context or reset?
Crash recovery: if process restarts mid-conversation, what state is recoverable vs lost?

severity_examples.condition: User mentioned deadline constraint early, falls out of 10-turn window, agent makes suggestions ignoring it
severity_examples.scenario: Context window cutoff loses critical constraint mentioned 12 turns ago

severity_examples.condition: _sessions dict cleared but Session table still has messages, next load uses stale DB data
severity_examples.scenario: /new clears in-memory history but not DB session, creating ghost context

success_hints: Focus on agent.py history management, telegram.py /new handler, and config.py MAX_CONTEXT_TURNS
task_context: F8 (state checkpoint) and the Transport refactor both involve handoff redesign
